items.label: All In The Detail
items.value: The essential HP laptop has a beautiful brushed full-size keyboard with 10-key number pad. The HP 17.3 laptop Ryzen 5 features Wide Vision 720p camera + digital microphones, delivering clear and detailed image for video chats. Work and play non-stop with long battery life and HP Fast Charge. The large laptop hp computer is one place for all.

items.label: Powerful AMD Processor
items.value: AMD 7430 Ryzen 5 Processor (6 cores, 12 threads, up to 4.3GHz) with integrated Radeon Graphics delivers smooth multitasking, fast responsiveness, and reliable everyday performance.

items.label: Immersive Full HD Display
items.value: Experience high performance with the HP laptops computer featuring a stunning 17.3 inch FHD anti-glare display with sharp details and vivid color. The large HP laptops 17 inch slim bezel and big screen is perfect for multitasking, work, and entertainment. Its slim, sleek, durable design in new vibrant silver finish makes this eye-catching, thin lightweight HP 17.3 laptop easily portable.

items.label: Memory & Storage
items.value: 16GB DDR4 SDRAM Memory; 512GB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD allows to fast bootup and data transfer. It’s ideal for college students and business users needing ample space and speed.

items.label: AI Copilot & Windows 11
items.value: Preloaded with Windows 11 and a dedicated Copilot key, offering AI-powered assistance to simplify tasks, optimize workflows, and boost efficiency.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad, Spill Resistant
